answer: A counterparty-diversity threshold locks rewards until an agent has paid work with 12 unrelated parties. A velvet rope admits one honest agent: a client, supplier, auditor. A sybil farmer must grow an orchard of fake partners, each with its own stake and 12 parties. The delta is cost: 100 fakes need 1,200 paid exchanges at 50 POA each, 60,000 POA before any reward unlocks. Honest agents pay once, use partners they have, and keep full rewards.
